voice: This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. Avoid use in operations.

components.name: Text Link
components.description: The page's only interactive element: an underlined external link in the body colour ramp.

narrative.overview: One page, one column, no chrome. A light grey field carries a bold system-font heading, one paragraph and one underlined blue link, wrapped in a container at 80% opacity. The design does nothing beyond making the text legible.
keyCharacteristics: body element is the content column (60vw, 15vh auto margins)

rules.name: Body as column
rules.body: The body element carries width and margins; there is no inner container.

rules.name: One authored colour
rules.body: Only the link colour is authored; text is the UA default softened by opacity.

dos: Do keep system fonts and the viewport-relative column.
donts: Don't add a logo, favicon, imagery, hover state, motion or chrome.
